liveFileTask.question: Develop and refine a downloadable Python file clamp_value.py and a downloadable unittest file test_clamp_value.py. Implement clamp_value(value, low, high). Accept only int or float values, reject booleans, reject NaN and infinities, reject low greater than high, and clamp inclusively. Preserve arbitrarily large finite Python integers without converting them to float. Include tests for each boundary, all rejection cases and an integer such as 10**400. Worker A implements complete files; worker B independently challenges edge cases and evidence. Use four concise improvement cycles. Run the tests if you have Python tools available, and report honest limitations. Both workers must verify the SAME candidate file bytes before finishing. Return actual downloadable files, not just code blocks or claimed links.
liveFileTask.instruction: Please strengthen the downloadable tests with deterministic randomized finite inputs (at least 200 cases), plus explicit rejection checks for every argument position. Keep the implementation simple and preserve huge integers. Have the other worker inspect the actual revised files and challenge missing coverage. Only report executed tests when there is execution evidence.
